definitions.explanation: Injury to body tissue caused by exposure to extreme cold, typically affecting extremities like fingers, toes, nose, and ears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{凍傷|とうしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got frostbite while mountain climbing.

examples.japanese: {凍傷|とうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧、⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦つけてください→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Please wear gloves properly to prevent frostbite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重度|じゅうど}→重度：28683_juudo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凍傷|とうしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切断|せつだん}しなければならなかった→切断する：20497_setsudan⟧。
examples.english: Due to severe frostbite, the fingers had to be amputated.

notes:
{凍傷|とうしょう} refers to frostbite, tissue damage from freezing. {凍|とう} means 'freeze' and {傷|しょう} means 'injury.'
